description: This file provides helper functions for calculating technical indicators used in stock analysis, such as SMA, EMA, RSI, trend summarization, and mock pattern detection, mainly intended for client-side demonstrations and not production use.

methods.name: calcSMA(values, period)
methods.description: Calculates the simple moving average series aligned to input length, returning null for insufficient points.

methods.name: calcEMA(values, period)
methods.description: Calculates the exponential moving average series aligned to input length, returning null for insufficient points.

methods.name: calcRSI(values, period)
methods.description: Calculates the Relative Strength Index (RSI) series aligned to input length, returning null for insufficient points.

methods.name: summarizeTrend(values)
methods.description: Returns a simple trend direction and momentum score based on the slope and volatility of the input values.

methods.name: mockDetectPatterns(values)
methods.description: A lightweight mock pattern detection that identifies potential double tops or triangles based on the series shape.
